title: Split raspberry_pi_flash_sd.sh and test_boot_repair.sh under the cap
objective: Bring raspberry_pi_flash_sd.sh (661) and test_boot_repair.sh (315) under the 250-line cap, choosing seams that avoid heredocs after the enforce_vbox_hosts failure.
acceptance_criteria: Both entry scripts and all four new libs are at most 250 lines.
The pre-commit shellcheck hook passes on every touched file, with no new suppression and no disable directive.
No lib sources a sibling; every lib parses under bash -n.
Every seam is chosen outside a heredoc: the heredoc line numbers are listed before picking cut points.
test_boot_repair.sh is a sandboxed fixture harness, so it MUST be run: it has to report the same pass count after the split as a clean worktree at HEAD reports before it.
raspberry_pi_flash_sd.sh is not executed - it writes partition tables to an SD card.
out_of_scope: Executing raspberry_pi_flash_sd.sh or any flashing step.
Changing what any script does when run.
verifier: meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh for both, plus running test_boot_repair.sh and comparing its pass count against the same script run from a detached worktree at HEAD, plus pre-commit run --files and check_file_length.sh.
